about.title: About · Starlight Isle
about.body1: Born before the arrival of 2027, Starlight Isle is a quiet winter island built on Truth, Goodness, and Beauty. Leave unspoken words, new year wishes, or say hello to someone across the world.
about.body2: Even long after January passes, this island stays open forever—so whenever loneliness visits, you can come back and watch the midnight fireworks rise with your local clock.
values: Zero sign-up & privacy first: no email or phone required; uploaded photos automatically strip EXIF location metadata.
Gentle moderation: bilingual safety filters, community reporting, and human review keep the night sky kind.
Open Source (MIT): welcome global contributors on GitHub to carry this warmth forward.
